meta.title: useEffect — out-of-order responses overwrite newer data

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: Search fires a request whenever the query changes. Two quick changes start two requests, and responses can arrive in a different order than they were sent.

annotations.label: Cleanup flips this run's flag
annotations.detail: The cleanup closes over `ignore` from its own run. When the query changes, React runs the old cleanup, so an old request can no longer call setResult.

steps.note: Without a guard, whichever response arrives LAST wins, even if it belongs
